column32: Law no. 14.020 institutes the Emergency Employment and Income Maintenance Program. The new law originates from Provisional Measure 936, issued by the government in early April. The program provides for the granting of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit to workers who have reduced working hours or a suspended contract, and also emergency assistance for intermittent workers with a formalized employment contract, under the terms of the provisional measure. The value of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit will be based on the calculation of the monthly amount of unemployment insurance to which the employee would be entitled. In the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  I - in the event of a reduction in working hours and wages, it will be calculated by applying the percentage of the reduction to the calculation basis; and  II - in the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  a) equivalent to 100% (one hundred percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  b) equivalent to 70% (seventy percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  Link: http://web.archive.org/web/20200716181745/http://www.in.gov.br/en/web/dou/-/lei-n-14.020-de-6-de-julho-de-2020-265386938  http://web.archive.org/web/20200716182541/https://www.gov.br/economia/pt-br/centrais-de-conteudo/publicacoes/boletins/covid-19/timeline/julho/7-de-julho-de-2020    No official declaration on the amount of the measure was mentioned. However, to guarantee the payment of the so-called Emergency Job and Income Preservation Benefit (BEm), the federal government will have to invest between R $ 26.1 and R $ 52.6 billion, according to an analysis by the Independent Tax Institution (IFI) of the Senate.   Link: http://web.archive.org/web/20200716182524/https://www2.senado.leg.br/bdsf/bitstream/handle/id/574054/NT44.pdf  Link:http://web.archive.org/web/20200716182552/https://www12.senado.leg.br/noticias/materias/2020/07/06/uniao-investira-ate-r-53-bi-para-compensar-reducao-de-salario-e-jornada-avalia-ifi

column29: According to Ordinance No 670, published on April 1st, 2022,    Brazilian or foreign international travelers are authorized to enter the country by air, provided that they present to the airline company responsible for the flight, before boarding, a printed or electronic proof of vaccination, in accordance with art. 14.    - The requirement to present proof of vaccination does not apply  I - to the traveler with a health condition that contraindicates vaccination, provided that it is attested by a medical report;  II - to those not eligible for vaccination due to age, according to criteria defined by the Ministry of Health in the National Operationalization Plan for Vaccination against Sars-Cov-2 (covid-19) and published on the Ministry of Health website;                III - to travelers entering the country due to humanitarian issues, in the form of art. 19;  IV - those coming from countries with low vaccination coverage, according to the Ministry of Health's website; and  V - Brazilians and foreigners residing in Brazil who have not been fully vaccinated.    Travelers without proof of vaccination must submit to the airline company responsible for the flight, before boarding, a document proving that a screening test for Sars-Cov-2 infection (covid-19) has been performed, with negative or non-detectable results, such as an antigen test or RT-PCR lab test performed one day before boarding.    Link: http://archive.today/HCjEn
column58: According to the Interministerial Ordinance No. 17 of March 22nd, imposed as of April 1st    Employees no longer need to wear Covid-19 protective masks at work if there are state or municipal decrees that dispense with the mask in closed places. In this case, the company is also no longer obliged to provide the protective equipment to employees.    However, for workers aged 60 or older or who present clinical conditions at risk for developing complications of Covid-19, when not teleworking or in remote work at the employer's discretion, surgical masks or masks of type PFF2 (N95) or equivalent must be provided.    Article with the new measures compiled: http://archive.today/4kYkC   Ordinance No 17: https://web.archive.org/web/20220919141927/https://static.poder360.com.br/2022/04/dou-mascaras-1abr2022.pdf

column32: Law no. 14.020 institutes the Emergency Employment and Income Maintenance Program. The new law originates from Provisional Measure 936, issued by the government in early April. The program provides for the granting of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit to workers who have reduced working hours or a suspended contract, and also emergency assistance for intermittent workers with a formalized employment contract, under the terms of the provisional measure. The value of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit will be based on the calculation of the monthly amount of unemployment insurance to which the employee would be entitled. In the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  I - in the event of a reduction in working hours and wages, it will be calculated by applying the percentage of the reduction to the calculation basis; and  II - in the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  a) equivalent to 100% (one hundred percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  b) equivalent to 70% (seventy percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  Link: http://web.archive.org/web/20200716181745/http://www.in.gov.br/en/web/dou/-/lei-n-14.020-de-6-de-julho-de-2020-265386938  http://web.archive.org/web/20200716182541/https://www.gov.br/economia/pt-br/centrais-de-conteudo/publicacoes/boletins/covid-19/timeline/julho/7-de-julho-de-2020    No official declaration on the amount of the measure was mentioned. However, to guarantee the payment of the so-called Emergency Job and Income Preservation Benefit (BEm), the federal government will have to invest between R $ 26.1 and R $ 52.6 billion, according to an analysis by the Independent Tax Institution (IFI) of the Senate.   Link: http://web.archive.org/web/20200716182524/https://www2.senado.leg.br/bdsf/bitstream/handle/id/574054/NT44.pdf  Link:http://web.archive.org/web/20200716182552/https://www12.senado.leg.br/noticias/materias/2020/07/06/uniao-investira-ate-r-53-bi-para-compensar-reducao-de-salario-e-jornada-avalia-ifi

column29: According to Ordinance No 670, published on April 1st, 2022,    Brazilian or foreign international travelers are authorized to enter the country by air, provided that they present to the airline company responsible for the flight, before boarding, a printed or electronic proof of vaccination, in accordance with art. 14.    - The requirement to present proof of vaccination does not apply  I - to the traveler with a health condition that contraindicates vaccination, provided that it is attested by a medical report;  II - to those not eligible for vaccination due to age, according to criteria defined by the Ministry of Health in the National Operationalization Plan for Vaccination against Sars-Cov-2 (covid-19) and published on the Ministry of Health website;                III - to travelers entering the country due to humanitarian issues, in the form of art. 19;  IV - those coming from countries with low vaccination coverage, according to the Ministry of Health's website; and  V - Brazilians and foreigners residing in Brazil who have not been fully vaccinated.    Travelers without proof of vaccination must submit to the airline company responsible for the flight, before boarding, a document proving that a screening test for Sars-Cov-2 infection (covid-19) has been performed, with negative or non-detectable results, such as an antigen test or RT-PCR lab test performed one day before boarding.    Link: http://archive.today/HCjEn
column58: According to the Interministerial Ordinance No. 17 of March 22nd, imposed as of April 1st    Employees no longer need to wear Covid-19 protective masks at work if there are state or municipal decrees that dispense with the mask in closed places. However, for workers aged 60 or older or who present clinical conditions at risk for developing complications of Covid-19, when not teleworking or in remote work at the employer's discretion, surgical masks or masks of type PFF2 (N95) or equivalent must be provided. column32: Law no. 14.020 institutes the Emergency Employment and Income Maintenance Program. The new law originates from Provisional Measure 936, issued by the government in early April. The program provides for the granting of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit to workers who have reduced working hours or a suspended contract, and also emergency assistance for intermittent workers with a formalized employment contract, under the terms of the provisional measure. The value of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit will be based on the calculation of the monthly amount of unemployment insurance to which the employee would be entitled. In the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  I - in the event of a reduction in working hours and wages, it will be calculated by applying the percentage of the reduction to the calculation basis; and  II - in the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  a) equivalent to 100% (one hundred percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  b) equivalent to 70% (seventy percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  Link: http://web.archive.org/web/20200716181745/http://www.in.gov.br/en/web/dou/-/lei-n-14.020-de-6-de-julho-de-2020-265386938  http://web.archive.org/web/20200716182541/https://www.gov.br/economia/pt-br/centrais-de-conteudo/publicacoes/boletins/covid-19/timeline/julho/7-de-julho-de-2020    No official declaration on the amount of the measure was mentioned. However, to guarantee the payment of the so-called Emergency Job and Income Preservation Benefit (BEm), the federal government will have to invest between R $ 26.1 and R $ 52.6 billion, according to an analysis by the Independent Tax Institution (IFI) of the Senate. column29: According to Ordinance No 670, published on April 1st, 2022,    Brazilian or foreign international travelers are authorized to enter the country by air, provided that they present to the airline company responsible for the flight, before boarding, a printed or electronic proof of vaccination, in accordance with art. 14.    - The requirement to present proof of vaccination does not apply  I - to the traveler with a health condition that contraindicates vaccination, provided that it is attested by a medical report;  II - to those not eligible for vaccination due to age, according to criteria defined by the Ministry of Health in the National Operationalization Plan for Vaccination against Sars-Cov-2 (covid-19) and published on the Ministry of Health website;                III - to travelers entering the country due to humanitarian issues, in the form of art. 19;  IV - those coming from countries with low vaccination coverage, according to the Ministry of Health's website; and  V - Brazilians and foreigners residing in Brazil who have not been fully vaccinated.    Travelers without proof of vaccination must submit to the airline company responsible for the flight, before boarding, a document proving that a screening test for Sars-Cov-2 infection (covid-19) has been performed, with negative or non-detectable results, such as an antigen test or RT-PCR lab test performed one day before boarding. column32: Law no. 14.020 institutes the Emergency Employment and Income Maintenance Program. The new law originates from Provisional Measure 936, issued by the government in early April. The program provides for the granting of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit to workers who have reduced working hours or a suspended contract, and also emergency assistance for intermittent workers with a formalized employment contract, under the terms of the provisional measure. The value of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit will be based on the calculation of the monthly amount of unemployment insurance to which the employee would be entitled. In the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  I - in the event of a reduction in working hours and wages, it will be calculated by applying the percentage of the reduction to the calculation basis; and  II - in the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  a) equivalent to 100% (one hundred percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  b) equivalent to 70% (seventy percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  Link: http://web.archive.org/web/20200716181745/http://www.in.gov.br/en/web/dou/-/lei-n-14.020-de-6-de-julho-de-2020-265386938  http://web.archive.org/web/20200716182541/https://www.gov.br/economia/pt-br/centrais-de-conteudo/publicacoes/boletins/covid-19/timeline/julho/7-de-julho-de-2020    No official declaration on the amount of the measure was mentioned. However, to guarantee the payment of the so-called Emergency Job and Income Preservation Benefit (BEm), the federal government will have to invest between R $ 26.1 and R $ 52.6 billion, according to an analysis by the Independent Tax Institution (IFI) of the Senate. column29: According to Ordinance No 670, published on April 1st, 2022,    Brazilian or foreign international travelers are authorized to enter the country by air, provided that they present to the airline company responsible for the flight, before boarding, a printed or electronic proof of vaccination, in accordance with art. 14.    - The requirement to present proof of vaccination does not apply  I - to the traveler with a health condition that contraindicates vaccination, provided that it is attested by a medical report;  II - to those not eligible for vaccination due to age, according to criteria defined by the Ministry of Health in the National Operationalization Plan for Vaccination against Sars-Cov-2 (covid-19) and published on the Ministry of Health website;                III - to travelers entering the country due to humanitarian issues, in the form of art. 19;  IV - those coming from countries with low vaccination coverage, according to the Ministry of Health's website; and  V - Brazilians and foreigners residing in Brazil who have not been fully vaccinated.    Travelers without proof of vaccination must submit to the airline company responsible for the flight, before boarding, a document proving that a screening test for Sars-Cov-2 infection (covid-19) has been performed, with negative or non-detectable results, such as an antigen test or RT-PCR lab test performed one day before boarding.    Link: http://archive.today/HCjEn
column58: According to the Interministerial Ordinance No. 17 of March 22nd, imposed as of April 1st    Employees no longer need to wear Covid-19 protective masks at work if there are state or municipal decrees that dispense with the mask in closed places. In this case, the company is also no longer obliged to provide the protective equipment to employees.    However, for workers aged 60 or older or who present clinical conditions at risk for developing complications of Covid-19, when not teleworking or in remote work at the employer's discretion, surgical masks or masks of type PFF2 (N95) or equivalent must be provided. column32: Law no. 14.020 institutes the Emergency Employment and Income Maintenance Program. The new law originates from Provisional Measure 936, issued by the government in early April. The program provides for the granting of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit to workers who have reduced working hours or a suspended contract, and also emergency assistance for intermittent workers with a formalized employment contract, under the terms of the provisional measure. The value of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit will be based on the calculation of the monthly amount of unemployment insurance to which the employee would be entitled. In the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  I - in the event of a reduction in working hours and wages, it will be calculated by applying the percentage of the reduction to the calculation basis; and  II - in the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  a) equivalent to 100% (one hundred percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  b) equivalent to 70% (seventy percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  Link: http://web.archive.org/web/20200716181745/http://www.in.gov.br/en/web/dou/-/lei-n-14.020-de-6-de-julho-de-2020-265386938  http://web.archive.org/web/20200716182541/https://www.gov.br/economia/pt-br/centrais-de-conteudo/publicacoes/boletins/covid-19/timeline/julho/7-de-julho-de-2020    No official declaration on the amount of the measure was mentioned. However, to guarantee the payment of the so-called Emergency Job and Income Preservation Benefit (BEm), the federal government will have to invest between R $ 26.1 and R $ 52.6 billion, according to an analysis by the Independent Tax Institution (IFI) of the Senate. column29: According to Ordinance No 670, published on April 1st, 2022,    Brazilian or foreign international travelers are authorized to enter the country by air, provided that they present to the airline company responsible for the flight, before boarding, a printed or electronic proof of vaccination, in accordance with art. 14.    - The requirement to present proof of vaccination does not apply  I - to the traveler with a health condition that contraindicates vaccination, provided that it is attested by a medical report;  II - to those not eligible for vaccination due to age, according to criteria defined by the Ministry of Health in the National Operationalization Plan for Vaccination against Sars-Cov-2 (covid-19) and published on the Ministry of Health website;                III - to travelers entering the country due to humanitarian issues, in the form of art. 19;  IV - those coming from countries with low vaccination coverage, according to the Ministry of Health's website; and  V - Brazilians and foreigners residing in Brazil who have not been fully vaccinated.    Travelers without proof of vaccination must submit to the airline company responsible for the flight, before boarding, a document proving that a screening test for Sars-Cov-2 infection (covid-19) has been performed, with negative or non-detectable results, such as an antigen test or RT-PCR lab test performed one day before boarding.    Link: http://archive.today/HCjEn

column32: Law no. 14.020 institutes the Emergency Employment and Income Maintenance Program. The new law originates from Provisional Measure 936, issued by the government in early April. The program provides for the granting of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit to workers who have reduced working hours or a suspended contract, and also emergency assistance for intermittent workers with a formalized employment contract, under the terms of the provisional measure. The value of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit will be based on the calculation of the monthly amount of unemployment insurance to which the employee would be entitled. In the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  I - in the event of a reduction in working hours and wages, it will be calculated by applying the percentage of the reduction to the calculation basis; and  II - in the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  a) equivalent to 100% (one hundred percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  b) equivalent to 70% (seventy percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  Link: http://web.archive.org/web/20200716181745/http://www.in.gov.br/en/web/dou/-/lei-n-14.020-de-6-de-julho-de-2020-265386938  http://web.archive.org/web/20200716182541/https://www.gov.br/economia/pt-br/centrais-de-conteudo/publicacoes/boletins/covid-19/timeline/julho/7-de-julho-de-2020    No official declaration on the amount of the measure was mentioned. However, to guarantee the payment of the so-called Emergency Job and Income Preservation Benefit (BEm), the federal government will have to invest between R $ 26.1 and R $ 52.6 billion, according to an analysis by the Independent Tax Institution (IFI) of the Senate. column62: The Ministry of Health published on Tuesday (06) a technical note updating the recommendations for vaccination against Covid-19 in pregnant and post-partum women up to 45 days post-partum.    The recommendations are   (a) Vaccinate pregnant women and puerperal (up to 45 days post-partum), from 18 years old, as a priority group, regardless of the presence of additional risk factors.  b) Vaccinate pregnant and post-partum women (up to 45 days after delivery), from 18 years of age, with vaccines that do not contain a viral vector (Sinovac/Butantan and Pfizer/Wyeth).  c) Vaccination can be given in any trimester of pregnancy.  d) Vaccination for pregnant and post-partum women (up to 45 days after delivery) over the age of 18 should be conditional on an individualized, shared assessment of the risk-benefit profile between the pregnant woman and her doctor, considering the evidence and uncertainties available to date.  e) Vaccination can be administered to lactating women who belong to one of the priority groups already listed at the time the respective group is convened. It is not necessary to interrupt lactation, however, lactation will not be considered a priority for vaccination.  f) For vaccination of pregnant and post-partum women, a medical prescription will be required.    Link: http://archive.today/Tr8rX

column32: Law no. 14.020 institutes the Emergency Employment and Income Maintenance Program. The new law originates from Provisional Measure 936, issued by the government in early April. The program provides for the granting of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit to workers who have reduced working hours or a suspended contract, and also emergency assistance for intermittent workers with a formalized employment contract, under the terms of the provisional measure. The value of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit will be based on the calculation of the monthly amount of unemployment insurance to which the employee would be entitled. In the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  I - in the event of a reduction in working hours and wages, it will be calculated by applying the percentage of the reduction to the calculation basis; and  II - in the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  a) equivalent to 100% (one hundred percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  b) equivalent to 70% (seventy percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  Link: http://web.archive.org/web/20200716181745/http://www.in.gov.br/en/web/dou/-/lei-n-14.020-de-6-de-julho-de-2020-265386938  http://web.archive.org/web/20200716182541/https://www.gov.br/economia/pt-br/centrais-de-conteudo/publicacoes/boletins/covid-19/timeline/julho/7-de-julho-de-2020    No official declaration on the amount of the measure was mentioned. However, to guarantee the payment of the so-called Emergency Job and Income Preservation Benefit (BEm), the federal government will have to invest between R $ 26.1 and R $ 52.6 billion, according to an analysis by the Independent Tax Institution (IFI) of the Senate. column29: According to Ordinance No 670, published on April 1st, 2022,    Brazilian or foreign international travelers are authorized to enter the country by air, provided that they present to the airline company responsible for the flight, before boarding, a printed or electronic proof of vaccination, in accordance with art. 14.    - The requirement to present proof of vaccination does not apply  I - to the traveler with a health condition that contraindicates vaccination, provided that it is attested by a medical report;  II - to those not eligible for vaccination due to age, according to criteria defined by the Ministry of Health in the National Operationalization Plan for Vaccination against Sars-Cov-2 (covid-19) and published on the Ministry of Health website;                III - to travelers entering the country due to humanitarian issues, in the form of art. 19;  IV - those coming from countries with low vaccination coverage, according to the Ministry of Health's website; and  V - Brazilians and foreigners residing in Brazil who have not been fully vaccinated. column32: Law no. 14.020 institutes the Emergency Employment and Income Maintenance Program. The new law originates from Provisional Measure 936, issued by the government in early April. The program provides for the granting of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit to workers who have reduced working hours or a suspended contract, and also emergency assistance for intermittent workers with a formalized employment contract, under the terms of the provisional measure. The value of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit will be based on the calculation of the monthly amount of unemployment insurance to which the employee would be entitled. In the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  I - in the event of a reduction in working hours and wages, it will be calculated by applying the percentage of the reduction to the calculation basis; and  II - in the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  a) equivalent to 100% (one hundred percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  b) equivalent to 70% (seventy percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  Link: http://web.archive.org/web/20200716181745/http://www.in.gov.br/en/web/dou/-/lei-n-14.020-de-6-de-julho-de-2020-265386938  http://web.archive.org/web/20200716182541/https://www.gov.br/economia/pt-br/centrais-de-conteudo/publicacoes/boletins/covid-19/timeline/julho/7-de-julho-de-2020    No official declaration on the amount of the measure was mentioned. However, to guarantee the payment of the so-called Emergency Job and Income Preservation Benefit (BEm), the federal government will have to invest between R $ 26.1 and R $ 52.6 billion, according to an analysis by the Independent Tax Institution (IFI) of the Senate. column29: According to Ordinance No 670, published on April 1st, 2022,    Brazilian or foreign international travelers are authorized to enter the country by air, provided that they present to the airline company responsible for the flight, before boarding, a printed or electronic proof of vaccination, in accordance with art. 14.    - The requirement to present proof of vaccination does not apply  I - to the traveler with a health condition that contraindicates vaccination, provided that it is attested by a medical report;  II - to those not eligible for vaccination due to age, according to criteria defined by the Ministry of Health in the National Operationalization Plan for Vaccination against Sars-Cov-2 (covid-19) and published on the Ministry of Health website;                III - to travelers entering the country due to humanitarian issues, in the form of art. 19;  IV - those coming from countries with low vaccination coverage, according to the Ministry of Health's website; and  V - Brazilians and foreigners residing in Brazil who have not been fully vaccinated.    Travelers without proof of vaccination must submit to the airline company responsible for the flight, before boarding, a document proving that a screening test for Sars-Cov-2 infection (covid-19) has been performed, with negative or non-detectable results, such as an antigen test or RT-PCR lab test performed one day before boarding.    Link: http://archive.today/HCjEn

column32: Law no. 14.020 institutes the Emergency Employment and Income Maintenance Program. The new law originates from Provisional Measure 936, issued by the government in early April. The program provides for the granting of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit to workers who have reduced working hours or a suspended contract, and also emergency assistance for intermittent workers with a formalized employment contract, under the terms of the provisional measure. The value of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit will be based on the calculation of the monthly amount of unemployment insurance to which the employee would be entitled. In the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  I - in the event of a reduction in working hours and wages, it will be calculated by applying the percentage of the reduction to the calculation basis; and  II - in the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  a) equivalent to 100% (one hundred percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  b) equivalent to 70% (seventy percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  Link: http://web.archive.org/web/20200716181745/http://www.in.gov.br/en/web/dou/-/lei-n-14.020-de-6-de-julho-de-2020-265386938  http://web.archive.org/web/20200716182541/https://www.gov.br/economia/pt-br/centrais-de-conteudo/publicacoes/boletins/covid-19/timeline/julho/7-de-julho-de-2020    No official declaration on the amount of the measure was mentioned. However, to guarantee the payment of the so-called Emergency Job and Income Preservation Benefit (BEm), the federal government will have to invest between R $ 26.1 and R $ 52.6 billion, according to an analysis by the Independent Tax Institution (IFI) of the Senate.   Link: http://web.archive.org/web/20200716182524/https://www2.senado.leg.br/bdsf/bitstream/handle/id/574054/NT44.pdf  Link:http://web.archive.org/web/20200716182552/https://www12.senado.leg.br/noticias/materias/2020/07/06/uniao-investira-ate-r-53-bi-para-compensar-reducao-de-salario-e-jornada-avalia-ifi

column55: For this first stage, the target audience for the national vaccination campaign against Covid-19 was prioritized according to the criteria of exposure to infection and higher risks for worsening and death from the disease, considering the amount of vaccine available. column29: According to Ordinance No 670, published on April 1st, 2022,    Brazilian or foreign international travelers are authorized to enter the country by air, provided that they present to the airline company responsible for the flight, before boarding, a printed or electronic proof of vaccination, in accordance with art. 14.    - The requirement to present proof of vaccination does not apply  I - to the traveler with a health condition that contraindicates vaccination, provided that it is attested by a medical report;  II - to those not eligible for vaccination due to age, according to criteria defined by the Ministry of Health in the National Operationalization Plan for Vaccination against Sars-Cov-2 (covid-19) and published on the Ministry of Health website;                III - to travelers entering the country due to humanitarian issues, in the form of art. 19;  IV - those coming from countries with low vaccination coverage, according to the Ministry of Health's website; and  V - Brazilians and foreigners residing in Brazil who have not been fully vaccinated.    Travelers without proof of vaccination must submit to the airline company responsible for the flight, before boarding, a document proving that a screening test for Sars-Cov-2 infection (covid-19) has been performed, with negative or non-detectable results, such as an antigen test or RT-PCR lab test performed one day before boarding.    Link: http://archive.today/HCjEn
column58: According to the Interministerial Ordinance No. 17 of March 22nd, imposed as of April 1st    Employees no longer need to wear Covid-19 protective masks at work if there are state or municipal decrees that dispense with the mask in closed places. In this case, the company is also no longer obliged to provide the protective equipment to employees.    However, for workers aged 60 or older or who present clinical conditions at risk for developing complications of Covid-19, when not teleworking or in remote work at the employer's discretion, surgical masks or masks of type PFF2 (N95) or equivalent must be provided.    Article with the new measures compiled: http://archive.today/4kYkC   Ordinance No 17: https://web.archive.org/web/20220919141927/https://static.poder360.com.br/2022/04/dou-mascaras-1abr2022.pdf

column32: Law no. 14.020 institutes the Emergency Employment and Income Maintenance Program. The new law originates from Provisional Measure 936, issued by the government in early April. The program provides for the granting of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit to workers who have reduced working hours or a suspended contract, and also emergency assistance for intermittent workers with a formalized employment contract, under the terms of the provisional measure. The value of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit will be based on the calculation of the monthly amount of unemployment insurance to which the employee would be entitled. In the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  I - in the event of a reduction in working hours and wages, it will be calculated by applying the percentage of the reduction to the calculation basis; and  II - in the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  a) equivalent to 100% (one hundred percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  b) equivalent to 70% (seventy percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  Link: http://web.archive.org/web/20200716181745/http://www.in.gov.br/en/web/dou/-/lei-n-14.020-de-6-de-julho-de-2020-265386938  http://web.archive.org/web/20200716182541/https://www.gov.br/economia/pt-br/centrais-de-conteudo/publicacoes/boletins/covid-19/timeline/julho/7-de-julho-de-2020    No official declaration on the amount of the measure was mentioned. However, to guarantee the payment of the so-called Emergency Job and Income Preservation Benefit (BEm), the federal government will have to invest between R $ 26.1 and R $ 52.6 billion, according to an analysis by the Independent Tax Institution (IFI) of the Senate.   Link: http://web.archive.org/web/20200716182524/https://www2.senado.leg.br/bdsf/bitstream/handle/id/574054/NT44.pdf  Link:http://web.archive.org/web/20200716182552/https://www12.senado.leg.br/noticias/materias/2020/07/06/uniao-investira-ate-r-53-bi-para-compensar-reducao-de-salario-e-jornada-avalia-ifi

column55: The Ministry of Health published on Tuesday (06) a technical note updating the recommendations for vaccination against Covid-19 in pregnant and post-partum women up to 45 days post-partum.    The recommendations are   (a) Vaccinate pregnant women and puerperal (up to 45 days post-partum), from 18 years old, as a priority group, regardless of the presence of additional risk factors.  b) Vaccinate pregnant and post-partum women (up to 45 days after delivery), from 18 years of age, with vaccines that do not contain a viral vector (Sinovac/Butantan and Pfizer/Wyeth).  c) Vaccination can be given in any trimester of pregnancy.  d) Vaccination for pregnant and post-partum women (up to 45 days after delivery) over the age of 18 should be conditional on an individualized, shared assessment of the risk-benefit profile between the pregnant woman and her doctor, considering the evidence and uncertainties available to date.  e) Vaccination can be administered to lactating women who belong to one of the priority groups already listed at the time the respective group is convened. It is not necessary to interrupt lactation, however, lactation will not be considered a priority for vaccination.  f) For vaccination of pregnant and post-partum women, a medical prescription will be required. column32: Law no. 14.020 institutes the Emergency Employment and Income Maintenance Program. The new law originates from Provisional Measure 936, issued by the government in early April. The program provides for the granting of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit to workers who have reduced working hours or a suspended contract, and also emergency assistance for intermittent workers with a formalized employment contract, under the terms of the provisional measure. The value of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit will be based on the calculation of the monthly amount of unemployment insurance to which the employee would be entitled. In the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  I - in the event of a reduction in working hours and wages, it will be calculated by applying the percentage of the reduction to the calculation basis; and  II - in the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  a) equivalent to 100% (one hundred percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  b) equivalent to 70% (seventy percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  Link: http://web.archive.org/web/20200716181745/http://www.in.gov.br/en/web/dou/-/lei-n-14.020-de-6-de-julho-de-2020-265386938  http://web.archive.org/web/20200716182541/https://www.gov.br/economia/pt-br/centrais-de-conteudo/publicacoes/boletins/covid-19/timeline/julho/7-de-julho-de-2020    No official declaration on the amount of the measure was mentioned. However, to guarantee the payment of the so-called Emergency Job and Income Preservation Benefit (BEm), the federal government will have to invest between R $ 26.1 and R $ 52.6 billion, according to an analysis by the Independent Tax Institution (IFI) of the Senate.   Link: http://web.archive.org/web/20200716182524/https://www2.senado.leg.br/bdsf/bitstream/handle/id/574054/NT44.pdf  Link:http://web.archive.org/web/20200716182552/https://www12.senado.leg.br/noticias/materias/2020/07/06/uniao-investira-ate-r-53-bi-para-compensar-reducao-de-salario-e-jornada-avalia-ifi

column29: According to Ordinance No 670, published on April 1st, 2022,    Brazilian or foreign international travelers are authorized to enter the country by air, provided that they present to the airline company responsible for the flight, before boarding, a printed or electronic proof of vaccination, in accordance with art. 14.    - The requirement to present proof of vaccination does not apply  I - to the traveler with a health condition that contraindicates vaccination, provided that it is attested by a medical report;  II - to those not eligible for vaccination due to age, according to criteria defined by the Ministry of Health in the National Operationalization Plan for Vaccination against Sars-Cov-2 (covid-19) and published on the Ministry of Health website;                III - to travelers entering the country due to humanitarian issues, in the form of art. 19;  IV - those coming from countries with low vaccination coverage, according to the Ministry of Health's website; and  V - Brazilians and foreigners residing in Brazil who have not been fully vaccinated.    Travelers without proof of vaccination must submit to the airline company responsible for the flight, before boarding, a document proving that a screening test for Sars-Cov-2 infection (covid-19) has been performed, with negative or non-detectable results, such as an antigen test or RT-PCR lab test performed one day before boarding.    Link: http://archive.today/HCjEn
column58: According to the Interministerial Ordinance No. 17 of March 22nd, imposed as of April 1st    Employees no longer need to wear Covid-19 protective masks at work if there are state or municipal decrees that dispense with the mask in closed places. In this case, the company is also no longer obliged to provide the protective equipment to employees.    However, for workers aged 60 or older or who present clinical conditions at risk for developing complications of Covid-19, when not teleworking or in remote work at the employer's discretion, surgical masks or masks of type PFF2 (N95) or equivalent must be provided.    Article with the new measures compiled: http://archive.today/4kYkC   Ordinance No 17: https://web.archive.org/web/20220919141927/https://static.poder360.com.br/2022/04/dou-mascaras-1abr2022.pdf

column29: The previous Ordinance is still in force, as it is not overwritten in the official website.     “According to Ordinance No 670, published on April 1st, 2022,    Brazilian or foreign international travelers are authorized to enter the country by air, provided that they present to the airline company responsible for the flight, before boarding, a printed or electronic proof of vaccination, in accordance with art. 14.    - The requirement to present proof of vaccination does not apply  I - to the traveler with a health condition that contraindicates vaccination, provided that it is attested by a medical report;  II - to those not eligible for vaccination due to age, according to criteria defined by the Ministry of Health in the National Operationalization Plan for Vaccination against Sars-Cov-2 (covid-19) and published on the Ministry of Health website;                III - to travelers entering the country due to humanitarian issues, in the form of art. 19;  IV - those coming from countries with low vaccination coverage, according to the Ministry of Health's website; and  V - Brazilians and foreigners residing in Brazil who have not been fully vaccinated.    Travelers without proof of vaccination must submit to the airline company responsible for the flight, before boarding, a document proving that a screening test for Sars-Cov-2 infection (covid-19) has been performed, with negative or non-detectable results, such as an antigen test or RT-PCR lab test performed one day before boarding.”    Link: http://archive.today/HCjEn
column58: According to the Interministerial Ordinance No. 17 of March 22nd, imposed as of April 1st    Employees no longer need to wear Covid-19 protective masks at work if there are state or municipal decrees that dispense with the mask in closed places. In this case, the company is also no longer obliged to provide the protective equipment to employees.    However, for workers aged 60 or older or who present clinical conditions at risk for developing complications of Covid-19, when not teleworking or in remote work at the employer's discretion, surgical masks or masks of type PFF2 (N95) or equivalent must be provided.    Article with the new measures compiled: http://archive.today/4kYkC   Ordinance No 17: https://web.archive.org/web/20220919141927/https://static.poder360.com.br/2022/04/dou-mascaras-1abr2022.pdf

column32: Law no. 14.020 institutes the Emergency Employment and Income Maintenance Program. The new law originates from Provisional Measure 936, issued by the government in early April. The program provides for the granting of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit to workers who have reduced working hours or a suspended contract, and also emergency assistance for intermittent workers with a formalized employment contract, under the terms of the provisional measure. The value of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit will be based on the calculation of the monthly amount of unemployment insurance to which the employee would be entitled. In the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  I - in the event of a reduction in working hours and wages, it will be calculated by applying the percentage of the reduction to the calculation basis; and  II - in the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  a) equivalent to 100% (one hundred percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  b) equivalent to 70% (seventy percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  Link: http://web.archive.org/web/20200716181745/http://www.in.gov.br/en/web/dou/-/lei-n-14.020-de-6-de-julho-de-2020-265386938  http://web.archive.org/web/20200716182541/https://www.gov.br/economia/pt-br/centrais-de-conteudo/publicacoes/boletins/covid-19/timeline/julho/7-de-julho-de-2020    No official declaration on the amount of the measure was mentioned. However, to guarantee the payment of the so-called Emergency Job and Income Preservation Benefit (BEm), the federal government will have to invest between R $ 26.1 and R $ 52.6 billion, according to an analysis by the Independent Tax Institution (IFI) of the Senate.   Link: http://web.archive.org/web/20200716182524/https://www2.senado.leg.br/bdsf/bitstream/handle/id/574054/NT44.pdf  Link:http://web.archive.org/web/20200716182552/https://www12.senado.leg.br/noticias/materias/2020/07/06/uniao-investira-ate-r-53-bi-para-compensar-reducao-de-salario-e-jornada-avalia-ifi

column29: The Superior Court of Justice (STJ) denied a request to suspend the requirement of negative PCR tests from people entering the country (Ordinance no. 630/2020). column29: According to Ordinance No 670, published on April 1st, 2022,    Brazilian or foreign international travelers are authorized to enter the country by air, provided that they present to the airline company responsible for the flight, before boarding, a printed or electronic proof of vaccination, in accordance with art. 14.    - The requirement to present proof of vaccination does not apply  I - to the traveler with a health condition that contraindicates vaccination, provided that it is attested by a medical report;  II - to those not eligible for vaccination due to age, according to criteria defined by the Ministry of Health in the National Operationalization Plan for Vaccination against Sars-Cov-2 (covid-19) and published on the Ministry of Health website;                III - to travelers entering the country due to humanitarian issues, in the form of art. 19;  IV - those coming from countries with low vaccination coverage, according to the Ministry of Health's website; and  V - Brazilians and foreigners residing in Brazil who have not been fully vaccinated.    Travelers without proof of vaccination must submit to the airline company responsible for the flight, before boarding, a document proving that a screening test for Sars-Cov-2 infection (covid-19) has been performed, with negative or non-detectable results, such as an antigen test or RT-PCR lab test performed one day before boarding. According to Ordinance No 670, published on April 1st, 2022,    Brazilian or foreign international travelers are authorized to enter the country by air, provided that they present to the airline company responsible for the flight, before boarding, a printed or electronic proof of vaccination, in accordance with art. 14.    - The requirement to present proof of vaccination does not apply  I - to the traveler with a health condition that contraindicates vaccination, provided that it is attested by a medical report;  II - to those not eligible for vaccination due to age, according to criteria defined by the Ministry of Health in the National Operationalization Plan for Vaccination against Sars-Cov-2 (covid-19) and published on the Ministry of Health website;                III - to travelers entering the country due to humanitarian issues, in the form of art. 19;  IV - those coming from countries with low vaccination coverage, according to the Ministry of Health's website; and  V - Brazilians and foreigners residing in Brazil who have not been fully vaccinated.    Travelers without proof of vaccination must submit to the airline company responsible for the flight, before boarding, a document proving that a screening test for Sars-Cov-2 infection (covid-19) has been performed, with negative or non-detectable results, such as an antigen test or RT-PCR lab test performed one day before boarding.    Link: http://archive.today/HCjEn
column58: According to the Interministerial Ordinance No. 17 of March 22nd, imposed as of April 1st    Employees no longer need to wear Covid-19 protective masks at work if there are state or municipal decrees that dispense with the mask in closed places. In this case, the company is also no longer obliged to provide the protective equipment to employees.    However, for workers aged 60 or older or who present clinical conditions at risk for developing complications of Covid-19, when not teleworking or in remote work at the employer's discretion, surgical masks or masks of type PFF2 (N95) or equivalent must be provided.    Article with the new measures compiled: http://archive.today/4kYkC   Ordinance No 17: https://web.archive.org/web/20220919141927/https://static.poder360.com.br/2022/04/dou-mascaras-1abr2022.pdf

column32: Law no. 14.020 institutes the Emergency Employment and Income Maintenance Program. The new law originates from Provisional Measure 936, issued by the government in early April. The program provides for the granting of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit to workers who have reduced working hours or a suspended contract, and also emergency assistance for intermittent workers with a formalized employment contract, under the terms of the provisional measure. The value of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit will be based on the calculation of the monthly amount of unemployment insurance to which the employee would be entitled. In the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  I - in the event of a reduction in working hours and wages, it will be calculated by applying the percentage of the reduction to the calculation basis; and  II - in the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  a) equivalent to 100% (one hundred percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  b) equivalent to 70% (seventy percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  Link: http://web.archive.org/web/20200716181745/http://www.in.gov.br/en/web/dou/-/lei-n-14.020-de-6-de-julho-de-2020-265386938  http://web.archive.org/web/20200716182541/https://www.gov.br/economia/pt-br/centrais-de-conteudo/publicacoes/boletins/covid-19/timeline/julho/7-de-julho-de-2020    No official declaration on the amount of the measure was mentioned. column32: Law no. 14.020 institutes the Emergency Employment and Income Maintenance Program. The new law originates from Provisional Measure 936, issued by the government in early April. The program provides for the granting of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit to workers who have reduced working hours or a suspended contract, and also emergency assistance for intermittent workers with a formalized employment contract, under the terms of the provisional measure. The value of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit will be based on the calculation of the monthly amount of unemployment insurance to which the employee would be entitled. In the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  I - in the event of a reduction in working hours and wages, it will be calculated by applying the percentage of the reduction to the calculation basis; and  II - in the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  a) equivalent to 100% (one hundred percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  b) equivalent to 70% (seventy percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  Link: http://web.archive.org/web/20200716181745/http://www.in.gov.br/en/web/dou/-/lei-n-14.020-de-6-de-julho-de-2020-265386938  http://web.archive.org/web/20200716182541/https://www.gov.br/economia/pt-br/centrais-de-conteudo/publicacoes/boletins/covid-19/timeline/julho/7-de-julho-de-2020    No official declaration on the amount of the measure was mentioned. However, to guarantee the payment of the so-called Emergency Job and Income Preservation Benefit (BEm), the federal government will have to invest between R $ 26.1 and R $ 52.6 billion, according to an analysis by the Independent Tax Institution (IFI) of the Senate. column29: According to Ordinance No 670, published on April 1st, 2022,    Brazilian or foreign international travelers are authorized to enter the country by air, provided that they present to the airline company responsible for the flight, before boarding, a printed or electronic proof of vaccination, in accordance with art. 14.    - The requirement to present proof of vaccination does not apply  I - to the traveler with a health condition that contraindicates vaccination, provided that it is attested by a medical report;  II - to those not eligible for vaccination due to age, according to criteria defined by the Ministry of Health in the National Operationalization Plan for Vaccination against Sars-Cov-2 (covid-19) and published on the Ministry of Health website;                III - to travelers entering the country due to humanitarian issues, in the form of art. 19;  IV - those coming from countries with low vaccination coverage, according to the Ministry of Health's website; and  V - Brazilians and foreigners residing in Brazil who have not been fully vaccinated.    Travelers without proof of vaccination must submit to the airline company responsible for the flight, before boarding, a document proving that a screening test for Sars-Cov-2 infection (covid-19) has been performed, with negative or non-detectable results, such as an antigen test or RT-PCR lab test performed one day before boarding.    Link: http://archive.today/HCjEn
column58: According to the Interministerial Ordinance No. 17 of March 22nd, imposed as of April 1st    Employees no longer need to wear Covid-19 protective masks at work if there are state or municipal decrees that dispense with the mask in closed places. In this case, the company is also no longer obliged to provide the protective equipment to employees.    However, for workers aged 60 or older or who present clinical conditions at risk for developing complications of Covid-19, when not teleworking or in remote work at the employer's discretion, surgical masks or masks of type PFF2 (N95) or equivalent must be provided. column32: Law no. 14.020 institutes the Emergency Employment and Income Maintenance Program. The new law originates from Provisional Measure 936, issued by the government in early April. The program provides for the granting of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit to workers who have reduced working hours or a suspended contract, and also emergency assistance for intermittent workers with a formalized employment contract, under the terms of the provisional measure. The value of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit will be based on the calculation of the monthly amount of unemployment insurance to which the employee would be entitled. In the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  I - in the event of a reduction in working hours and wages, it will be calculated by applying the percentage of the reduction to the calculation basis; and  II - in the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  a) equivalent to 100% (one hundred percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  b) equivalent to 70% (seventy percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  Link: http://web.archive.org/web/20200716181745/http://www.in.gov.br/en/web/dou/-/lei-n-14.020-de-6-de-julho-de-2020-265386938  http://web.archive.org/web/20200716182541/https://www.gov.br/economia/pt-br/centrais-de-conteudo/publicacoes/boletins/covid-19/timeline/julho/7-de-julho-de-2020    No official declaration on the amount of the measure was mentioned. However, to guarantee the payment of the so-called Emergency Job and Income Preservation Benefit (BEm), the federal government will have to invest between R $ 26.1 and R $ 52.6 billion, according to an analysis by the Independent Tax Institution (IFI) of the Senate. column32: Law no. 14.020 institutes the Emergency Employment and Income Maintenance Program. The new law originates from Provisional Measure 936, issued by the government in early April. The program provides for the granting of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit to workers who have reduced working hours or a suspended contract, and also emergency assistance for intermittent workers with a formalized employment contract, under the terms of the provisional measure. The value of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit will be based on the calculation of the monthly amount of unemployment insurance to which the employee would be entitled. In the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  I - in the event of a reduction in working hours and wages, it will be calculated by applying the percentage of the reduction to the calculation basis; and  II - in the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  a) equivalent to 100% (one hundred percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  b) equivalent to 70% (seventy percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  Link: http://web.archive.org/web/20200716181745/http://www.in.gov.br/en/web/dou/-/lei-n-14.020-de-6-de-julho-de-2020-265386938  http://web.archive.org/web/20200716182541/https://www.gov.br/economia/pt-br/centrais-de-conteudo/publicacoes/boletins/covid-19/timeline/julho/7-de-julho-de-2020    No official declaration on the amount of the measure was mentioned. However, to guarantee the payment of the so-called Emergency Job and Income Preservation Benefit (BEm), the federal government will have to invest between R $ 26.1 and R $ 52.6 billion, according to an analysis by the Independent Tax Institution (IFI) of the Senate.   Link: http://web.archive.org/web/20200716182524/https://www2.senado.leg.br/bdsf/bitstream/handle/id/574054/NT44.pdf  Link:http://web.archive.org/web/20200716182552/https://www12.senado.leg.br/noticias/materias/2020/07/06/uniao-investira-ate-r-53-bi-para-compensar-reducao-de-salario-e-jornada-avalia-ifi

column55: The Ministry of Health published on Tuesday (06) a technical note updating the recommendations for vaccination against Covid-19 in pregnant and post-partum women up to 45 days post-partum.    The recommendations are   (a) Vaccinate pregnant women and puerperal (up to 45 days post-partum), from 18 years old, as a priority group, regardless of the presence of additional risk factors.  b) Vaccinate pregnant and post-partum women (up to 45 days after delivery), from 18 years of age, with vaccines that do not contain a viral vector (Sinovac/Butantan and Pfizer/Wyeth).  c) Vaccination can be given in any trimester of pregnancy.  d) Vaccination for pregnant and post-partum women (up to 45 days after delivery) over the age of 18 should be conditional on an individualized, shared assessment of the risk-benefit profile between the pregnant woman and her doctor, considering the evidence and uncertainties available to date.  e) Vaccination can be administered to lactating women who belong to one of the priority groups already listed at the time the respective group is convened. It is not necessary to interrupt lactation, however, lactation will not be considered a priority for vaccination.  f) For vaccination of pregnant and post-partum women, a medical prescription will be required. column29: According to Ordinance No 670, published on April 1st, 2022,    Brazilian or foreign international travelers are authorized to enter the country by air, provided that they present to the airline company responsible for the flight, before boarding, a printed or electronic proof of vaccination, in accordance with art. 14.    - The requirement to present proof of vaccination does not apply  I - to the traveler with a health condition that contraindicates vaccination, provided that it is attested by a medical report;  II - to those not eligible for vaccination due to age, according to criteria defined by the Ministry of Health in the National Operationalization Plan for Vaccination against Sars-Cov-2 (covid-19) and published on the Ministry of Health website;                III - to travelers entering the country due to humanitarian issues, in the form of art. 19;  IV - those coming from countries with low vaccination coverage, according to the Ministry of Health's website; and  V - Brazilians and foreigners residing in Brazil who have not been fully vaccinated.    Travelers without proof of vaccination must submit to the airline company responsible for the flight, before boarding, a document proving that a screening test for Sars-Cov-2 infection (covid-19) has been performed, with negative or non-detectable results, such as an antigen test or RT-PCR lab test performed one day before boarding.    Link: http://archive.today/HCjEn

column32: Law no. 14.020 institutes the Emergency Employment and Income Maintenance Program. The new law originates from Provisional Measure 936, issued by the government in early April. The program provides for the granting of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit to workers who have reduced working hours or a suspended contract, and also emergency assistance for intermittent workers with a formalized employment contract, under the terms of the provisional measure. The value of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit will be based on the calculation of the monthly amount of unemployment insurance to which the employee would be entitled. In the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  I - in the event of a reduction in working hours and wages, it will be calculated by applying the percentage of the reduction to the calculation basis; and  II - in the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  a) equivalent to 100% (one hundred percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  b) equivalent to 70% (seventy percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  Link: http://web.archive.org/web/20200716181745/http://www.in.gov.br/en/web/dou/-/lei-n-14.020-de-6-de-julho-de-2020-265386938  http://web.archive.org/web/20200716182541/https://www.gov.br/economia/pt-br/centrais-de-conteudo/publicacoes/boletins/covid-19/timeline/julho/7-de-julho-de-2020    No official declaration on the amount of the measure was mentioned. However, to guarantee the payment of the so-called Emergency Job and Income Preservation Benefit (BEm), the federal government will have to invest between R $ 26.1 and R $ 52.6 billion, according to an analysis by the Independent Tax Institution (IFI) of the Senate.   Link: http://web.archive.org/web/20200716182524/https://www2.senado.leg.br/bdsf/bitstream/handle/id/574054/NT44.pdf  Link:http://web.archive.org/web/20200716182552/https://www12.senado.leg.br/noticias/materias/2020/07/06/uniao-investira-ate-r-53-bi-para-compensar-reducao-de-salario-e-jornada-avalia-ifi

The Federal Government has extended deadlines for the Emergency Employment and Income Maintenance Program for another two months. The term for the temporary suspension of the contract, which was 60 days, also changes to 120. For employees with intermittent employment contracts, the decree establishes the payment of an emergency benefit of R $ 600.00 for another month, counting from the closing date of the three-month period, for employees with formalized employment contracts until April 1, publication date of the PM creating the program. column62: The Ministry of Health published on Tuesday (06) a technical note updating the recommendations for vaccination against Covid-19 in pregnant and post-partum women up to 45 days post-partum.    The recommendations are   (a) Vaccinate pregnant women and puerperal (up to 45 days post-partum), from 18 years old, as a priority group, regardless of the presence of additional risk factors.  b) Vaccinate pregnant and post-partum women (up to 45 days after delivery), from 18 years of age, with vaccines that do not contain a viral vector (Sinovac/Butantan and Pfizer/Wyeth).  c) Vaccination can be given in any trimester of pregnancy.  d) Vaccination for pregnant and post-partum women (up to 45 days after delivery) over the age of 18 should be conditional on an individualized, shared assessment of the risk-benefit profile between the pregnant woman and her doctor, considering the evidence and uncertainties available to date.  e) Vaccination can be administered to lactating women who belong to one of the priority groups already listed at the time the respective group is convened. It is not necessary to interrupt lactation, however, lactation will not be considered a priority for vaccination.  f) For vaccination of pregnant and post-partum women, a medical prescription will be required.    Link: http://archive.today/Tr8rX

column32: Law no. 14.020 institutes the Emergency Employment and Income Maintenance Program. The new law originates from Provisional Measure 936, issued by the government in early April. The program provides for the granting of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit to workers who have reduced working hours or a suspended contract, and also emergency assistance for intermittent workers with a formalized employment contract, under the terms of the provisional measure. The value of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit will be based on the calculation of the monthly amount of unemployment insurance to which the employee would be entitled. In the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  I - in the event of a reduction in working hours and wages, it will be calculated by applying the percentage of the reduction to the calculation basis; and  II - in the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  a) equivalent to 100% (one hundred percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  b) equivalent to 70% (seventy percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  Link: http://web.archive.org/web/20200716181745/http://www.in.gov.br/en/web/dou/-/lei-n-14.020-de-6-de-julho-de-2020-265386938  http://web.archive.org/web/20200716182541/https://www.gov.br/economia/pt-br/centrais-de-conteudo/publicacoes/boletins/covid-19/timeline/julho/7-de-julho-de-2020    No official declaration on the amount of the measure was mentioned. However, to guarantee the payment of the so-called Emergency Job and Income Preservation Benefit (BEm), the federal government will have to invest between R $ 26.1 and R $ 52.6 billion, according to an analysis by the Independent Tax Institution (IFI) of the Senate. column29: According to Ordinance No 670, published on April 1st, 2022,    Brazilian or foreign international travelers are authorized to enter the country by air, provided that they present to the airline company responsible for the flight, before boarding, a printed or electronic proof of vaccination, in accordance with art. 14.    - The requirement to present proof of vaccination does not apply  I - to the traveler with a health condition that contraindicates vaccination, provided that it is attested by a medical report;  II - to those not eligible for vaccination due to age, according to criteria defined by the Ministry of Health in the National Operationalization Plan for Vaccination against Sars-Cov-2 (covid-19) and published on the Ministry of Health website;                III - to travelers entering the country due to humanitarian issues, in the form of art. 19;  IV - those coming from countries with low vaccination coverage, according to the Ministry of Health's website; and  V - Brazilians and foreigners residing in Brazil who have not been fully vaccinated.    Travelers without proof of vaccination must submit to the airline company responsible for the flight, before boarding, a document proving that a screening test for Sars-Cov-2 infection (covid-19) has been performed, with negative or non-detectable results, such as an antigen test or RT-PCR lab test performed one day before boarding. However, for workers aged 60 or older or who present clinical conditions at risk for developing complications of Covid-19, when not teleworking or in remote work at the employer's discretion, surgical masks or masks of type PFF2 (N95) or equivalent must be provided. Brazilians and foreigners residing in Brazil who have not been fully vaccinated.    The federal government prohibited the entry into the country of foreign passengers on flights originating from or passing through African countries.    Borders are now open for those presenting a PCR negative result or proof of vaccination, there is no need to quarantine.    Link: http://archive.today/hH1DL

column29: According to Ordinance No 670, published on April 1st, 2022,    Brazilian or foreign international travelers are authorized to enter the country by air, provided that they present to the airline company responsible for the flight, before boarding, a printed or electronic proof of vaccination, in accordance with art. 14.    - The requirement to present proof of vaccination does not apply  I - to the traveler with a health condition that contraindicates vaccination, provided that it is attested by a medical report;  II - to those not eligible for vaccination due to age, according to criteria defined by the Ministry of Health in the National Operationalization Plan for Vaccination against Sars-Cov-2 (covid-19) and published on the Ministry of Health website;                III - to travelers entering the country due to humanitarian issues, in the form of art. 19;  IV - those coming from countries with low vaccination coverage, according to the Ministry of Health's website; and  V - Brazilians and foreigners residing in Brazil who have not been fully vaccinated.    Travelers without proof of vaccination must submit to the airline company responsible for the flight, before boarding, a document proving that a screening test for Sars-Cov-2 infection (covid-19) has been performed, with negative or non-detectable results, such as an antigen test or RT-PCR lab test performed one day before boarding.    Link: http://archive.today/HCjEn
column58: According to the Interministerial Ordinance No. 17 of March 22nd, imposed as of April 1st    Employees no longer need to wear Covid-19 protective masks at work if there are state or municipal decrees that dispense with the mask in closed places. However, for workers aged 60 or older or who present clinical conditions at risk for developing complications of Covid-19, when not teleworking or in remote work at the employer's discretion, surgical masks or masks of type PFF2 (N95) or equivalent must be provided. column32: Law no. 14.020 institutes the Emergency Employment and Income Maintenance Program. The new law originates from Provisional Measure 936, issued by the government in early April. The program provides for the granting of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit to workers who have reduced working hours or a suspended contract, and also emergency assistance for intermittent workers with a formalized employment contract, under the terms of the provisional measure. The value of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit will be based on the calculation of the monthly amount of unemployment insurance to which the employee would be entitled. column32: Law no. 14.020 institutes the Emergency Employment and Income Maintenance Program. The new law originates from Provisional Measure 936, issued by the government in early April. The program provides for the granting of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit to workers who have reduced working hours or a suspended contract, and also emergency assistance for intermittent workers with a formalized employment contract, under the terms of the provisional measure. The value of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit will be based on the calculation of the monthly amount of unemployment insurance to which the employee would be entitled. In the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  I - in the event of a reduction in working hours and wages, it will be calculated by applying the percentage of the reduction to the calculation basis; and  II - in the event of temporary suspension of the employment contract, it will have monthly value:  a) equivalent to 100% (one hundred percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  b) equivalent to 70% (seventy percent) of the unemployment insurance amount to which the employee would be entitled  Link: http://web.archive.org/web/20200716181745/http://www.in.gov.br/en/web/dou/-/lei-n-14.020-de-6-de-julho-de-2020-265386938  http://web.archive.org/web/20200716182541/https://www.gov.br/economia/pt-br/centrais-de-conteudo/publicacoes/boletins/covid-19/timeline/julho/7-de-julho-de-2020    No official declaration on the amount of the measure was mentioned. However, to guarantee the payment of the so-called Emergency Job and Income Preservation Benefit (BEm), the federal government will have to invest between R $ 26.1 and R $ 52.6 billion, according to an analysis by the Independent Tax Institution (IFI) of the Senate. column29: According to Ordinance No 670, published on April 1st, 2022,    Brazilian or foreign international travelers are authorized to enter the country by air, provided that they present to the airline company responsible for the flight, before boarding, a printed or electronic proof of vaccination, in accordance with art. 14.    - The requirement to present proof of vaccination does not apply  I - to the traveler with a health condition that contraindicates vaccination, provided that it is attested by a medical report;  II - to those not eligible for vaccination due to age, according to criteria defined by the Ministry of Health in the National Operationalization Plan for Vaccination against Sars-Cov-2 (covid-19) and published on the Ministry of Health website;                III - to travelers entering the country due to humanitarian issues, in the form of art. 19;  IV - those coming from countries with low vaccination coverage, according to the Ministry of Health's website; and  V - Brazilians and foreigners residing in Brazil who have not been fully vaccinated.    Travelers without proof of vaccination must submit to the airline company responsible for the flight, before boarding, a document proving that a screening test for Sars-Cov-2 infection (covid-19) has been performed, with negative or non-detectable results, such as an antigen test or RT-PCR lab test performed one day before boarding.    Link: http://archive.today/HCjEn

column32: Law no. 14.020 institutes the Emergency Employment and Income Maintenance Program. The new law originates from Provisional Measure 936, issued by the government in early April. The program provides for the granting of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit to workers who have reduced working hours or a suspended contract, and also emergency assistance for intermittent workers with a formalized employment contract, under the terms of the provisional measure. The value of the Emergency Employment and Income Preservation Benefit will be based on the calculation of the monthly amount of unemployment insurance to which the employee would be entitled. column62: The Ministry of Health published on Tuesday (06) a technical note updating the recommendations for vaccination against Covid-19 in pregnant and post-partum women up to 45 days post-partum.    The recommendations are   (a) Vaccinate pregnant women and puerperal (up to 45 days post-partum), from 18 years old, as a priority group, regardless of the presence of additional risk factors.  b) Vaccinate pregnant and post-partum women (up to 45 days after delivery), from 18 years of age, with vaccines that do not contain a viral vector (Sinovac/Butantan and Pfizer/Wyeth).  c) Vaccination can be given in any trimester of pregnancy.  d) Vaccination for pregnant and post-partum women (up to 45 days after delivery) over the age of 18 should be conditional on an individualized, shared assessment of the risk-benefit profile between the pregnant woman and her doctor, considering the evidence and uncertainties available to date.  e) Vaccination can be administered to lactating women who belong to one of the priority groups already listed at the time the respective group is convened. It is not necessary to interrupt lactation, however, lactation will not be considered a priority for vaccination.  f) For vaccination of pregnant and post-partum women, a medical prescription will be required.    Link: http://archive.today/Tr8rX
